name: commit
description: Stage only meaningful vetted changed paths, then commit; rejects generated/cache-only changes.

repoPath.description: Git checkout to stage vetted changes in and commit.

message.description: Commit message; defaults to 'conductor-code change' when omitted.

commit.description: Resulting commit SHA (HEAD after the commit, or the current HEAD when noOp).

stagedPaths.description: Paths staged and committed; empty when noOp.

rejectedPaths.description: Vetted-change-eligible paths rejected during staging (e.g. protected deletions).

noOp.description: True when there was nothing meaningful to stage/commit.

reason.description: Explanation for a no-op commit; present only when noOp is true.
